krafttraining.title: Strength Training
krafttraining.intro: Health-oriented strength training leads to a better general condition — and is the most effective prevention against chronic musculoskeletal pain.
benefitTexts: Building strength reserves for everyday demands and sport.
Prevents neck tension, back and joint pain.
Strengthens bones through stimulation of bone density.
paras: Weak muscles are always partly responsible for acute and chronic musculoskeletal pain, leading to tension, inflammation and ultimately pain under additional strain and wear on joints, tendons or intervertebral discs.
An increase in strength compensates for the natural loss of muscle and creates stability in joints and the spine — relieving painful soft tissues such as ligaments, tendons and intervertebral discs.

The main benefit of machine-based training lies in the measurable resistance, gradually increased until age-appropriate strength is achieved. Movement is guided, making it easy on the joints. Strong muscles keep people mobile and independent even in old age.

herzKreislauf.title: Cardio & Circulation
herzKreislauf.intro: Cardio training leads to a more efficient cardiovascular system with improved muscle blood flow — and can be carried out at any age.
herzKreislauf.benefitsLabel: What a trained cardiovascular system achieves
benefits: Greater blood ejection volume per heartbeat
New blood vessel formation in stronger muscles
Improved oxygen supply and energy provision
Faster removal of metabolic waste products such as lactic acid
herzKreislauf.para: To perform well in everyday life and sport, physical endurance is essential — to avoid premature fatigue and to recover as quickly as possible from exertion.
herzKreislauf.recommendationText: Health-oriented cardiovascular training is carried out 1–2 times per week for approximately 20 minutes.

hilfeSchmerzen.title: Pain Relief
hilfeSchmerzen.intro: Neck, back and joint pain is treated at the Medlake Centre by three specialist doctors using state-of-the-art computerised strengthening equipment — supported by physiotherapists.
hilfeSchmerzen.para1: An integrated medical and physiotherapy practice is available for treatment and emergencies.
hilfeSchmerzen.para2: You will find 540 m² with a large MedX equipment park with high-quality back machines, as well as high-quality LIFEFITNESS recumbent bikes, upright bikes and cross-trainers in a separate room.
hilfeSchmerzen.insuranceText: Therapy costs are covered by all health insurers. A contribution towards an annual subscription is also covered.

firmenfitness.para: Alongside professional training and development, physical fitness is an essential foundation for company quality and productivity. We motivate your teams towards more movement and better health — with measurable results.

medX.title: Medical Training Therapy (MED-X)
medX.intro: Computerised MedX devices promote muscle development in the neck and lumbar region with maximum precision — each therapy session is an individual treatment with the doctor.
medX.para1: Thanks to optimal patient fixation, auxiliary muscles can be completely eliminated, resulting in optimal strengthening of the target musculature. The device settings allow for measured movement within the pain-free range.
medX.para2: Training can be performed gently and in a controlled manner with pound-range weights, documented time and movement repetition — allowing training after an acute pain episode, joint blockages or back surgery.
medX.analysisText: Based on the measured values, the computer calculates the patient's strength curve, which is compared with age-, sex- and weight-specific standard data.
indications: Insufficient strength in the back extensor muscles

physiotherapie.title: Physiotherapy & MTT
physiotherapie.intro: Medical training therapy to increase the resilience of the musculoskeletal system — individually tailored, therapeutically supervised, and recognised by health insurers.
physiotherapie.para1: MTT is used to increase the resilience of the musculoskeletal system. Using strength, endurance, mobilisation, flexibility and coordination, the musculoskeletal system and cardiovascular system are trained to support rehabilitation processes.
physiotherapie.para2: The training programme is created by a physiotherapist and individually tailored to the patient — taking into account medical diagnoses, the current rehabilitation phase and physical conditions.
focusTexts: Targeted muscle building in the affected area.
physiotherapie.insuranceText: An MTT referral is issued by your doctor and lasts 3 months. Costs are generally covered by basic or accident insurance. We recommend continuing training with us after the referral period.

kinesis.title: KINESIS Training
kinesis.intro: KINESIS — Greek for movement. Unique full-body training through cable resistance against gravity over a very wide range of motion.
kinesis.para1: The concept based on Technogym KINESIS is called ›Full Gravity‹. Naturally flowing exercise execution is specifically promoted. KINESIS is not a replacement for conventional training — rather a highly effective complement.
kinesis.para2: A wide variety of exercises in minimal space is possible at the Technogym KINESIS station — covering a broad range of athletic goals with minimal time requirements.
focusTexts: Efficient muscle building through functional resistance.
Targeted stretching for all body regions.
kinesis.suitableText: Advanced and ambitious athletes can carry out a complete training programme through special movement patterns. In physiotherapy, the KINESIS station is used for targeted rehabilitation training.

galileo.title: Galileo Vibration Plate
galileo.intro: Alternating side vibration movements cause muscles to contract more frequently via stretch reflexes — precisely adjustable for sport, rehabilitation and pain therapy.
galileo.para: The stimulation can be individually increased and adjusted via the duration, frequency setting, foot position and body posture.
uses: Rehabilitation after injury and painful conditions
Neurological conditions such as MS, Parkinson's, incomplete paralysis
contra: New implants in the leg area
